Level 3 — Components inside the Podman CLI.
Builds, runs, and manages containers locally or via
Core container engine logic. Statically linked into the CLI and
REST API binaries; not a separate process. Owns Runtime
and all container/pod/volume lifecycle, OCI invocation, state
Process boot (reexec, podmansh shim, logging, syslog,
terminal setup). Assembles the Cobra root and wires
Owns the global Commands slice that every subpackage's
accessors. Selects ABIMode vs TunnelMode based on OS and
One Cobra subtree per resource (containers, pods, images,
volumes, networks, secrets, manifest, artifact, kube, quadlet,
farm, generate, healthcheck, system). Each verb file declares a
cobra.Command and a RunE that calls
Cross-cutting CLI plumbing: create/run flag sets, autocomplete
helpers, Cobra arg validators, parse/inspect/diff helpers reused
The 'podman system service' command. The only place under
cmd/podman/ that holds a raw *libpod.Runtime — constructs
one via infra.GetRuntime and hands it to
Manages local virtual machines that host Podman on
non-Linux hosts (init, start, stop, ssh, cp, …). Implementation
Lifecycle of Quadlet unit files (install, list, print, remove). The
'podman completion' emits shell completion scripts. Distinct
from the runtime autocomplete helpers in CLI-C4.
Automated pipeline platform (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab
CI, …) that triggers container build, test, and deploy workflows.
